title: Is Palindrome
description:
Write a function `isPalindrome` that returns `true` if a string reads the same forwards and backwards. Ignore case and spaces.

**Example:**
```js
isPalindrome('racecar') // true
isPalindrome('A man a plan a canal Panama') // true
isPalindrome('hello') // false
```
ai_context: Learners often forget to normalize the string before comparing — not stripping spaces causes 'A man a plan a canal Panama' to return false. Another pitfall: only lowercasing but forgetting to strip spaces, or stripping punctuation when the problem only requires ignoring spaces.
